div.div: 64 garment kinds, 11 attribute families with 81 values, 9 occasions. One OWL file, the same for every tab.

div.span: the system prompt of every classify call

div.div: Describe the photo with these terms only
The kinds, their parts and the allowed values go into the prompt as a list. The model picks from the list.
Every kind, value and part is looked up in the ontology
Anything not in it is reported as what the ontology could not express, next to the answer.

div.data-message: Please only hide this attribution when you are subscribed to React Flow Pro: https://reactflow.dev/attribution

div.span: what comes back, so the ontology grows
